description: This file defines API routes for managing notes in a FastAPI application. It includes endpoints to create, list, retrieve, update, delete, pin, and favorite notes, utilizing dependencies such as database sessions and settings.

methods.name: NoteOut create_note_endpoint(payload: NoteCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Creates a new note using provided data and database session.

methods.name: NoteListResponse list_notes_endpoint( q: Optional[str] = Query(default=None, description="Search query (matches title/content)."), tag: Optional[str] = Query(default=None, description="Filter by a tag name."), pinned: Optional[bool] = Query(default=None, description="Filter by pinned flag."), favorite: Optional[bool] = Query(default=None, description="Filter by favorite flag."), limit: int = Query(default=None, ge=1, le=1000, description="Page size."), offset: int = Query(default=0, ge=0, description="Offset for pagination."), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Lists or searches notes based on query parameters like search term, tags, pinned, and favorite filters.

methods.name: NoteOut get_note_endpoint(note_id: UUID, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Retrieves a specific note by its UUID.

methods.name: NoteOut update_note_endpoint(note_id: UUID, payload: NoteUpdate, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Updates fields of an existing note identified by UUID.

methods.name: dict delete_note_endpoint(note_id: UUID, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Deletes a note by its UUID.

methods.name: NoteOut set_note_pin_endpoint( note_id: UUID, pinned: bool = Query(..., description="Pinned state to set."), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Sets the pinned state of a note.

methods.name: NoteOut set_note_favorite_endpoint( note_id: UUID, favorite: bool = Query(..., description="Favorite state to set."), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Sets the favorite state of a note.
